I will first list all fixed positions (Eve=3, Mya=2, Ada=6) and then systematically fill the remaining slots (1, 4, 5, 7) by applying the inequalities: Joe > Mya (so Joe > 2), Mel > Joe, Mel < Ada (so Mel < 6), and Rob > Mya (so Rob > 2). I will calculate the exact integer values for each person step-by-step before selecting the option for who finished second.
